name: After § 32
title: REPORT on the 2023 and 2024 Commission reports on Bosnia and Herzegovina
part_text: 32a. Recalls that BiH is a key transit country for irregular immigration on the Balkan route; considers that tackling local mafia and police corruption facilitating smuggling networks should be a priority; underlines that ‘safe houses’ hosting illegal migrants are actually part of human trafficking networks and that violence and torture are reported in some of these places, mostly targeting women;
